# nikke-k2f-check

> PowerShell scripts to detect and contain the NIKKE PC launcher supply-chain malware (K2F RAT, insightjs.com, 2026-09-27 to 2026-11-04): read-only detection, quarantine-based remediation, persistence sweep, CDN ETag check.

## Read-only route (no execution needed)

- [Facts and sources](docs/FACTS.md): every indicator, timeline entry and ETag with its source
- [Developer doc](docs/DEVELOPER.md): verdict logic, verification results, limits
- [Player guide content](docs/index.explainer.json): the text of the player-facing page
- [Detector source](Check-K2F.ps1): what is read and how verdicts are decided
- [Fixture tests](tests/Run-FixtureTests.ps1): one positive and one negative case per check; results recorded in the developer doc

## Run

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): facts and steps for an agent helping a user
- [README.md](README.md) / [README.en.md](README.en.md)
